question: How big can the quick commerce industry become in India by 2030?
idealClarificationQuestions: Total quick commerce GMV across all players? Yes.
Categories: grocery + impulse + non-grocery (electronics, beauty, fashion)? All.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Addressable population × penetration × order frequency × AOV.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Quick commerce addressable cities by 2030: ~80-100 cities (currently 25-30).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Active quick commerce users (any frequency): ~12-15 crore by 2030.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average order value (mature, with non-grocery upselling): ~₹500.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~₹3-3.5 lakh Cr GMV potential by 2030.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average orders per active user per year
Average order value (mature, with non-grocery upselling)
